title: Etale acyclicity of a quasi-coherent module on an affine
statement:
Let $X$ be an affine scheme and $\mathcal F$ a quasi-coherent module.
Then $H^q(X_{\mathrm{et}},\mathcal F_{\mathrm{et}})=0$ for $q>0$,
with the associated sheaf of
Definition [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module].

proof.text: Take B to be affine objects and Cov to be finiteAffineEtaleCechCover. The proved finiteAffineEtaleCechCover_basis gives fibre-product stability and cofinality; the covering condition is part of Cov.

Use isZero_etaleTensorSectionsSheaf_ulift_cech for positive Cech vanishing of the lifted sheaf. Apply isZero_rightDerived_etale_of_cech_vanishing to obtain zero positive derived evaluation at every affine object.

The identity etale object T=X is terminal by MorphismProperty.Over.mkIdTerminal and affine by the hypothesis. Write q=n+1. The proved cohomology_nonempty_addEquiv_rightDerived_evaluation_succ identifies Sheaf.H G (n+1) with derived evaluation at T. Convert its IsZero witness to Subsingleton and transport along the injective additive equivalence.

split_report.summary: Rebuilt the proof using the reviewed generic Cech vanishing criterion (Stacks 03F9). The obsolete spectral-sequence route and its locality child were removed. The three steps verify the criterion's affine fibre-product closure, cofinal finite affine etale refinements, and Amitsur Cech exactness via the standard-cover comparison, then identify evaluation at X with etale cohomology.
split_report.blueprint: The steps realize the blueprint's two proof paragraphs by replacing the unsupported spectral-sequence edge argument with the generic 03F9 criterion, while retaining the disjoint-union and Amitsur calculation.

tool_uses.why: Step 1 and Step 3 use the generic 03F9 site criterion; it is a reviewed tool from sk-thm-p1 and the repaired route has no replacement within sk-prop-h2.
Step 2 uses the affine sections/tensor-product calculation for pulled-back quasi-coherent modules.
Step 2 uses pullback coherence to identify the face maps.
Step 2 (reviewer fix): pullback of a quasi-coherent module is quasi-coherent, generic scheme fact.
Step 3 (reviewer fix): a bounded-below complex of injectives is K-injective, identifying derived evaluation at X with etale cohomology.
